name: Barabbas
background: A militant revolutionary imprisoned for murder and insurrection. He was released by the crowd in place of Jesus.

genericReactions.physical: A weapon? It's a tool for freedom, nothing more.
genericReactions.testimonial: I care about actions, not empty words.
genericReactions.digital: Scribbles on a scroll? The real record is written in blood and freedom.
genericReactions.environmental: The land cries out for liberation, not for us to inspect the dirt.
genericReactions.analytical: You can't count the spirit of a revolution.
genericReactions.prophecy: I make my own destiny. I don't wait for prophecies.
